description:
Outcome: coordinator sees all 40 plots and holders in a grid, from brief.md original First version 5 explicitly deferred by owner.
Scope: private schematic grid, occupied/empty states and holder names from canonical allocations; accessible equivalent list and owner walkthrough. Excludes: public/gardener map, GIS/physical geography, payments and tool lending.
Acceptance: exactly 40 plots; accurate holders/empty states; changes reflected on refresh; contacts and other-household records inaccessible to gardeners; coordinator confirms usefulness.
Behaviour: accessible keyboard/list alternative, large readable phone/zoom layout, non-color-only status and loading/empty/error/stale recovery.
Verification: full/partial/empty fixtures, role isolation and mobile/keyboard walkthrough. Prerequisites: first-version launch; explicitly excluded from first-version acceptance. Assumptions: schematic grid because physical layout unspecified.
title: Coordinator plot map after first version
